title: A `require` or `autoload` path literal completes as a path, an `autoload` root or glob links to its directory, and a directory link reveals it in the Explorer
scope:
Path completion and links inside the path literals of `require` and `autoload`, the trigger characters that open
that list, and what the VS Code client does with a link to a directory. Completion of any other string is not decided here.
dependsOnText:
[0099](0099.md) (the request set, and `documentLink` as a projection of the walk), [0193](0193.md)
(trigger characters answered only where a spelling ends).

summary.headline: Paths complete and link in the editor
summary.body:
Inside the path of a `require`, an `autoload` root or an `autoload discover` glob, the editor lists the
folders and `.nvs` files in the folder the path reaches so far. An `autoload` path lists folders only.
Ctrl+click on an `autoload` root or glob shows its folder in the Explorer.
